args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays. Affected versions are <2.9.4; fixed in 2.9.4.

args.body:
## What
Upgrades the pinned `fastjson` dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt`.

## Why
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected range is <2.9.4, so 2.9.4 is the minimal fixing version on the 2.x line (3.1.0 also fixes it, but requires a major-version upgrade).

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
